visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Result of concat Is Thrown Away
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Flattening [1,[2,[3,[4]],5]] should give [1,2,3,4,5], but the program prints only [1].

solution.explanation: concat does not change the array it is called on; it returns a new array. If the returned array is not assigned to something, the flattened inner items are lost.
